启动 AlgoRover Live（可选本机或自己的 VPS 运行），打开 Dashboard，然后立即开始交互式策略引导。
AlgoRover Live를 이 컴퓨터 또는 내 VPS에 준비하고 대시보드를 연 다음 대화형 전략 안내를 바로 시작하세요.
interface.longDescription: Mention AlgoRover Live alone to open the Dashboard and interactive strategy onboarding. Route specific strategy, backtest and attended paper/demo/live requests to the AlgoRover Runtime, which runs on this computer or on your own Linux VPS so strategies keep running while the computer is off.
